items.name: fresh-only outputs
items.evidence: These directories do not exist: <EvidenceRoot>/matrix, primary, capacity, and <AssetRoot>/data/matrix, data/primary. <AssetRoot>/data contains only smoke/.

risks: The coordinator reports 9 ferrots-suite processes. While they exist, both runners stop at the start assert, by design. The stop happens before any output is written.

p2-completion.py quiet-probes uses generator.competing_load(). That function matches only exact names and has no runner-script or suffix match, so it does not detect a running replay/capacity runner or its candidate-*.exe child. Do not run quiet-probes during P4-P6. If it runs during a runner, the runner records it only in the next per-run scan.
quiet-probes rewrites state.json (stage_probes only; status prefix kept). Runners read state.json only at start; a concurrent rewrite can only cause a start failure before any output exists.
If quiet-probes leaves a nonempty -wal on the A250 DB, capacity stops at its WAL assert. This is a stop, not a false pass. quiet-probes checks the DB hash afterwards but not the WAL size.
Ancestor exclusion uses psutil parent PIDs. A stale parent PID that Windows reused for another process would be excluded from the scan. Likelihood is low.
Script-name matching uses substrings (for example builder.py). An unrelated python cmdline that contains one of these names blocks start; this is a false stop, not a false pass.

Not changed since the first review: state.json SHA256 and the P2 oracle summary hash are not recorded in execution-contract.json. The candidate source label is the hash of inputs/candidate-copy-after.json. Neither runner checks dist. Do not change the status prefix before capacity ends.
